7e4f39a5.source: We use and carry only the highest-quality, performance-based hair products, developed by experts in France, the Netherlands and California. Whatever we use on you in the chair is on the shelf on your way out.

f690721e.source: Plant-based, research-backed care for hair and scalp — and it retails exclusively at Sublime.

18dd3499.source: René Furterer is a luxury line designed specifically to improve the condition of your hair and scalp. Backed by pharmaceutical research and produced using the finest plant-based essential oils, it is at the top of its class for hair and scalp treatment.

d9fdd9ea.source: Proven results, beautifully presented, and available in Ottawa only at Sublime.

be2425da.source: Men's grooming pomades that "hold like wax and wash out like gel."

2df818c8.source: For over two decades, Layrite Men's Grooming Products have been setting the benchmark for traditional barbering and men's grooming around the world. Their water-soluble pomades "hold like wax and wash out like gel," says founder Donnie Hawley.

207fd944.source: Whether your hair is straight, wavy, curly, coarse and thick or fine and thin, there's a shine from matte to super-shine and a hold for texture and volume. The name came from a regular who told Donnie the products "make hair lay right" — and a brand was born.

c7ddc729.source: The Scumbag Barbers' pomades, made for pompadours, quiffs, flat-tops and fades.

e083265b.source: Reuzel was formulated over two decades ago by the "Scumbag Barbers", Leen and Bertus, who needed a product worthy of their newly founded Schorem barbershop. What began as a line for their signature pompadours, quiffs, flat-tops and fades quickly became a global mainstay for barbers and clients alike.

f29fc694.source: The range covers wonderfully scented styling, shaving and beard products for every hair type. We carry most of the pomades, and anything else in the line can be special ordered.

0be772a5.source: Heritage European haircare, from long-lasting colour to restorative treatments.

88a9cc2f.source: Keune is a heritage European brand devoted to the artistry of professional haircare. Founded in 1922, it blends scientific innovation with premium, ethically sourced ingredients, and each formula is crafted with precision, sustainability and care — from vibrant, long-lasting colour to restorative treatments for hair and scalp.

9010c4cf.source: How long does creative colour actually take?

ee0a578b.source: Between four and seven hours, and occasionally two appointments. If your photo shows pastel over dark hair, it is almost certainly two. We would rather tell you that now than at hour five.

b6cdc8aa.source: Do I need a patch test?

5448ba05.source: Yes, for any colour service, and it has to be at least 48 hours before. It takes two minutes at the front desk — swing by, or book it alongside a fringe trim.

253e835d.source: I used box dye. Will you still see me?

56c0e29c.source: Yes. Tell us when you book so we can put enough time aside, and bring the box if you still have it. The ingredients list genuinely helps.

2424bee9.source: Please reschedule or cancel at least 48 hours before your appointment; later than that, there is a $50 cancellation fee. We take a credit card when you book, and it is only charged if you cancel within those 48 hours.

f122a3fd.source: What products do you use, and can I buy them?

de140f8b.source: We work with René Furterer and Keune — salon lines you'll only find at Sublime in Ottawa — plus Layrite and Reuzel for men's grooming. Whatever we use on you in the chair is on the shelf on your way out, and we will tell you the two things worth buying rather than the whole range.

a55c3b75.source: Please do. Bring several, including ones you dislike — knowing what you do not want is often more useful than knowing what you do.

67cd3e93.source: Yes, from about age five. A children's cut (under 10) is $35, and a youth cut (10–18) starts at $55. Under five is usually better at a place set up for it, and we will happily point you at one.

db0dcb49.source: Creative colour, vivids, balayage, glosses and colour correction at Sublime Hair Studio in Ottawa's Golden Triangle — how a colour day works, what it costs, and the work.

ca9273dc.source: Colour is what people climb the stairs for: vivids that stay bright, pastels over a proper lightening plan, balayage that grows out on purpose, and corrections for the box dye nobody needs to apologise for.

5fdf4a77.source: Book a colour consult See colour prices

6966c20b.source: The plan is made at the consult, so on the day nobody is improvising with bleach. You'll know how many sittings it takes, what it costs, and what it will look like in six weeks, before anything is mixed.

76136c1b.source: A quick look at the consult notes and your photos, including the ones you don't like.

c82d8722.source: Slow and even, checked the whole way. This is the part that decides how bright the colour gets.

76cdcf3c.source: Placement, panels, shadow roots — painted section by section, the way it was planned.

6daa01f9.source: A gloss to seal it, a cut to finish it, and aftercare that keeps it bright.

df089b1e.source: Prices move with length, density, and how much of a rescue mission we are on. You get a firm number at the consult, before anything starts.

f644bdfc.source: Bright on purpose, soft on purpose

4f00e681.source: Yes, for any colour service, and it has to be at least 48 hours before. It takes two minutes at the front desk — swing by, or do it at the end of another appointment.

8efec5d4.source: Pastels soften in a few weeks; deeper jewel tones hold longer. Wash cool, wash less, use a colour-safe shampoo — we keep Keune and René Furterer on the shelf, which almost nowhere else in Ottawa does — and book a gloss between bigger appointments to keep it bright.

5100e71a.source: Balayage is painted by hand and grows out softly, so you come back in months, not weeks. Foils give a brighter, more even result that needs a closer eye on the regrowth. We'll tell you which suits your hair at the consult.

df08931e.source: No deposit, but we take a credit card when you book. It is only charged — a $50 cancellation fee — if you cancel or reschedule within 48 hours of your appointment.

57d89ecc.source: Meet Sonia, owner of Sublime Hair Studio — apprenticed at 13, trained with Vidal Sassoon and Toni & Guy, master of cut and colour — and Charlotte and Bijou, the studio dogs.

fac5c26c.source: Sublime Hair Studio is built on the idea that every client deserves a style that is the outcome of creativity and originality. Tucked in amongst the restaurants, shops and small businesses that line Ottawa's buzzing Elgin Street, Sublime is a small, private space that offers a warm welcome, attentive service and unparalleled expertise.

447da19c.source: Open for over a decade, Sublime has been executing modern and sophisticated styles, transcending trends that Sonia and her team have consistently adapted to. Through the years, trust has remained at the centre of the client experience. Whether it's the product, cut, colour or conversation, clients leave knowing their needs were the focus of every appointment.

d4ab9778.source: Sublime Hair Studio is an outlet for Sonia's creative imagination and unique stylistic approaches. She puts an incredible amount of dedication into creating a personalized, memorable experience for every person who sits in her chair — and has built a reputation for innovative cut and colour techniques along the way.

db677332.source: Book with Sonia Discover her work

afff4bcb.source: Punk, and an apprenticeship at thirteen

ef14f259.source: Sonia's career began with a passion for punk hairstyles. She started her apprenticeship at the very young age of 13, among European hairstylists, and that is where she built her foundation.

24ffaa32.source: She went on to learn from the world's best academies and mentors — Vidal Sassoon, Toni & Guy London, Schwarzkopf, Alain Larivée and Anthony Edge — and became a master hair cutter with a genius for colour formulation.

31503df0.source: In the early 2000s Sonia returned to Ottawa from New York City, freshly inspired by the cutting-edge SoHo loft salons where the client experience came first. She envisioned a salon with the same obsession for style and service — and rejected the notion that high-fashion hair needs a "so-cool-it's-cold" room.

1ded1c64.source: Her skill, precision and experience became a studio that puts the individual first: every look starts with an in-depth consultation, and her attention to her clients is matched only by her attention to detail in the work.

b0f93bc7.source: Sonia excels at men's hair and barbering, and at the other end of the spectrum she is a true alchemist with colour. Sublime is a full-service salon — a destination for everyone.

4d1a0fea.source: Natural or dramatic colour, a sophisticated classic cut or something curly, funky and avant-garde: she will pour her passion and technique into the look you envision.

15a94954.source: Not everyone on the team holds scissors.

fd4511d8.source: Upon entering Sublime, you'll be greeted by a friendly bark and tail wag from Charlotte, a miniature golden doodle. Charlotte loves to spend her time between her shampoo chair and a vintage hair dryer near her Momma, Sonia.

5c3c19a4.source: Although Charlotte keeps to herself while the team is busy at work, you may notice her beautiful big brown eyes catching yours, along with the odd plea for a smooch or a pet as you pass her. Offer her a treat and she'll love you forever.

2d490b92.source: For those who aren't really dog friendly, she may just win you over. With her golden locks and calm demeanour, Charlotte brings a smile to nearly every client — even if you aren't much of a dog person, you may just become a "Charlotte person" by the time you pet her on your way out the door.

8211966e.source: Upon entering Sublime, you'll be greeted by a cheerful bark and a wagging tail from Bijou, our miniature poodle and beloved salon dog. Charlotte's younger brother, he is inquisitive, calm and charming, and his gentle personality wins over every guest who walks through our door.

b254fd70.source: You'll often find him lounging by the window, keeping a watchful eye on the neighbourhood, or admiring your new style from a distance while he waits to welcome the next client.

32910b94.source: Outside of the salon, Bijou enjoys strolls across the E.B. Eddy Bridge to Aylmer, exploring the Glebe, and sampling new treat combinations.

f4c023c4.source: We take on one apprentice a year, and when a chair opens up it usually goes to someone who has already emailed us.
